comment: Five steps over three carbons at x = 0, 5 and 10, carrying the four metadata fields. Step 1 states none of them (so it exercises the defaults and forms an untitled chapter); steps 2-3 and 4-5 differ in phase but share a layer, so they are two chapters rather than one. Step 4 deletes what step 2 created and step 5 only moves a base atom, which is what makes the ms_added / ms_layer membership rules observable.

steps.note: seed hydrogen, no metadata at all
layer-1 hydrogen on the first carbon
layer-1 hydrogen on the second carbon
take back the hydrogen step 2 put down
move a base carbon; creates nothing
